rss: Christmas toy rush being driven by squishies and building sets
title: Toy Boom: Squishies and Bricks Soar!
story: Kids are going wild for squishy toys and building blocks this year. These toys are flying off the shelves. People are talking about how much time kids spend playing with screens versus playing with these cool, creative toys.
storyBig: The toy industry is experiencing a significant boost, with squishy toys and building sets leading the charge. This trend comes amid ongoing discussions about balancing screen time with more traditional, hands-on play experiences.
think: Why do you think kids like squishy toys and building blocks so much?
bull: Playing with these toys lets you use your imagination.
bear: Some might prefer playing video games instead.

rss: US inflation higher than expected in October - here's what is happening with prices
title: Prices Climb: What It Means for You
story: Things are getting a bit more expensive. The prices of food, energy, and other items are going up. This means you might need more money to buy your favorite treats or toys.
storyBig: Inflation rates have increased, leading to higher costs for essentials like food and energy. This economic trend affects purchasing power and may influence spending habits.
think: What can you do if your favorite candy gets more expensive?
bull: It’s a chance to learn about saving and budgeting.
bear: Things might cost more, so you can’t buy as much with your allowance.
